facts.fact: ch17 开场以第二人称对全体读者说话：你也去过梦幻岛
facts.anchor: Once you were there too. You too dreamed of it, or saw it in the face of a dying friend

facts.fact: 坠落改写为出床跌进星空与海
facts.anchor: Let’s say you fell out of bed, when you were little. The floor opened up under you

facts.fact: 挥手才发现不是坠落而是飞行
facts.anchor: You flailed your arms in the air, then realised that you weren’t falling. You were flying

facts.fact: 橡椰榆榛同林生长：科学让位于更古老的规则
facts.anchor: In theory they couldn’t grow together, but here they do, because here the laws of science give way to older rules

facts.fact: 岛的定义式否定三连：没有父母、老师、偷走周日的神父
facts.anchor: There were no parents to shout at you, no teachers to punish you, and there were no priests to steal your Sunday

facts.fact: 虎百合是酋长之女，一箭猎野牛，向空中的「你」点头致意
facts.anchor: whose name was Tiger Lily. One time you saw her all alone, following the tracks of a bison, which she felled with a single arrow

facts.fact: 空心树里睡的是无父无母的 Lost Children
facts.anchor: You can’t have forgotten the hollow tree where the Lost Children slept, alone, with no mama, no papa

facts.fact: 孩子们说 Peter 或 Hook 早晚回来，毫不焦虑
facts.anchor: the Children would say, not in the least disturbed

facts.fact: 岛的道德公理：不危险者不美
facts.anchor: you knew that nothing can be beautiful that is not dangerous

facts.fact: Baddy Long Legs：八腿双头对称动物
facts.anchor: with a long spindly body held up by eight spider legs, and two whiplike heads—one in front, and one behind in place of a tail

facts.fact: 它慢食活物因其爱活肉的味道
facts.anchor: keeping it alive to the last, because it loved the taste of living flesh

facts.fact: 初次冒险与初次知美同地
facts.anchor: It was here that you risked your life for the first time, and it was here that you discovered how beautiful life is

facts.fact: 第一节末两词收束对读者的召唤
facts.anchor: Welcome back.

facts.fact: Giovanni 醒来感官恢复顺序：气味—声音—视觉
facts.anchor: Bread, potatoes, roasted meat: they find their way to Giovanni’s nostrils

facts.fact: 他在草棚里躺在树叶沙堆上
facts.anchor: He finds that he’s in a straw-roofed shack, lying on a heap of leaves and sand bundled up in fabric

facts.fact: 手表停摆；Wendy 凭光影判时间
facts.anchor: This doesn’t work here. A bit after midday, anyhow

facts.fact: Giovanni 问发生了什么，Giada 当面直陈被强奸
facts.anchor: “I was raped,” Giada says

facts.fact: 她补一句杀了人并请求换话题
facts.anchor: A pirate. I killed him. Can we change the subject, please?

facts.fact: 端培根的孩子是 Weirdo：他也迷路到了岛上
facts.anchor: I got lost yesterday too, I got lost

facts.fact: Nibs 说 Weirdo 总错过冒险——Barrie 原著也有这号人物
facts.anchor: he’s touchy about adventures. He almost always misses them

facts.fact: Wendy 警告 Giovanni 别犯导师「岛只是传说」式的错误
facts.anchor: Don’t make the same mistake as him

facts.fact: Wendy 说 Augusto 绑架 Luisa，Giada 纠正其真名
facts.anchor: He is Captain Hook.

facts.fact: Giovanni 清点失去：昨天父亲死、母亲疑已被 Hook 所杀
facts.anchor: Yesterday Papa died. And Mama …

facts.fact: 海滩上木柴堆成两米多高的截顶金字塔柴堆
facts.anchor: A wood pyre rises on the beach, not far from the water

facts.fact: 柴堆顶上是 Stefano 与 Silvia 的遗体
facts.anchor: On the top, the Lost Children have placed the bodies of Stefano and Silvia

facts.fact: 是孩子把末代林中之王抬到岛上
facts.anchor: It was they who carried the last King of the Woods to the Island

facts.fact: 只剩 Irene 能致敬，Flesh 的法律不让她办大葬礼
facts.anchor: Only Irene was left to honour him, and the laws of Flesh would not let her organise the great celebration that he deserves

facts.fact: 他着绿蓝、身旁是爱人的天青长袍
facts.anchor: They have dressed him in green and blue, and they laid beside him the body of the woman he loved, magnificent in an azure robe

facts.fact: Lost 共六十人围成半圆
facts.anchor: The Lost—sixty of them in total—are arranged in a semicircle around the pyramid

facts.fact: Wendy 不哭：把悲伤原地留着喂愤怒
facts.anchor: She wants to leave it where it is, feeding her rage

facts.fact: Pan 的扈从=寻乐者、妓女等「值得称赞者」组成的神的游戏班子
facts.anchor: It’s the ancient Retinue of Pan, reconstructed for the new age: a group of pleasure-seekers, whores, and other praiseworthy individuals who take part in the god’s games

facts.fact: Tito 吹 Charlie Parker 老蓝调
facts.anchor: Tito the saxophonist is playing a delicate melody, an old Charlie Parker blues tune

facts.fact: Peter 演说开场：死者应得欢乐
facts.anchor: our dead deserve joy

facts.fact: 哭泣会滞留灵魂——所以要解放他们
facts.anchor: Weeping holds back their souls, imprisons them: we want to liberate them

facts.fact: 神学要点：唯 Flesh 偶然死，Dream 与 Enchantment 靠守而永恒
facts.anchor: Only Flesh dies by chance. Dream and Enchantment are eternal, if we can keep them so

facts.fact: Nemi 王统因 Stefano 之死断绝
facts.anchor: no longer has a King, and the line of succession is broken

facts.fact: 颂词：几乎无人如他懂 Enchantment、且逼近 Dream 之本性
facts.anchor: he knew Enchantment like few others, and he even came close to understanding the nature of Dream

facts.fact: 点名指控：Hook 杀了 Silvia
facts.anchor: A woman like that, and Captain Hook killed her

facts.fact: Hook 曾在 Peter 显形前袭击他，但慢而钝
facts.anchor: He tried to get to me before I manifested, but he was slow and dull

facts.fact: 宣战缘由：Luisa 被掳
facts.anchor: He also kidnapped Luisa, a beautiful young woman, bound to Giovanni Cavaterra

facts.fact: 悼念之后次日夺回活人
facts.anchor: Tomorrow we go to take back our living one

facts.fact: 演说以开战口号收
facts.anchor: To war!

facts.fact: 火光中 Giovanni 看见 Luisa 的脸
facts.anchor: In the fire, Giovanni sees Luisa’s face

facts.fact: Giovanni 自省在 Peter 面前不清醒、坚持自主
facts.anchor: he isn’t lucid in Peter’s presence

facts.fact: 救回 Luisa 也要带她远离 Peter
facts.anchor: And away from Peter Pan, too.

facts.fact: 夜泳时有人拽住他的脚踝
facts.anchor: Then someone yanks at him

facts.fact: 出水的女子美到停心跳
facts.anchor: she is a heartstopping beauty

facts.fact: 水下有手握住他的阳具
facts.anchor: Under the water a hand grasps his member

facts.fact: Giovanni 拒以身外情为由
facts.anchor: I have a girlfriend

facts.fact: 意志在群美夹攻下瓦解
facts.anchor: As Giovanni’s will crumbles, one of the girls seizes his hand and brings it to her breast

facts.fact: Giovanni 以逻辑盘问背叛的阈值
facts.anchor: Is touching a breast betrayal?

facts.fact: 腿的位置是鱼尾与巨尾——她们是美人鱼
facts.anchor: … below her hips it meets rough scales, fishskin, a huge tail where legs should be, obviously they’re mermaids

facts.fact: Tinker Bell 抱臂悬空喝止，像恼火的母亲
facts.anchor: “Leave him alone,” says Tinker Bell. Arms folded, motionless in mid-air, she regards the mermaids with the air of an annoyed mother

facts.fact: Giovanni 问她们是不是塞壬
facts.anchor: They were sirens, weren’t they

facts.fact: Tinker Bell 定义：她们的歌是欲望，用整个身体唱
facts.anchor: Their song is Desire, and they sing it with their whole bodies

facts.fact: 直陈风险：做到死
facts.anchor: They would have fucked you until they killed you

facts.fact: 更冷的一句：对不欲者她们才施加别的
facts.anchor: They inflict those on people they don’t desire

facts.fact: Giovanni 的结论：幻想庞大到会碾死人
facts.anchor: fantasy is large, and like every large thing, it can crush you

facts.fact: 节五视角转神：Pan 眺望海盗船
facts.anchor: The god Pan scans the horizon, observing the pirate ship

facts.fact: 双方视线在中间某点相遇
facts.anchor: their gazes meet, each aware of the other

facts.fact: 化身后第一个真正的念头：阿卡迪亚已失
facts.anchor: Arcadia is lost, thinks Pan, and it is the first real thought he’s formulated since incarnating

facts.fact: 迷狂之神偶作反思
facts.anchor: he is a god of ecstasy, but every so often even he reflects

facts.fact: 新纪元属于 Hook
facts.anchor: An age that belongs to Captain Hook

facts.fact: 牢笼变弱，Peter 感觉得到
facts.anchor: The prison is weak now, Peter Pan feels it

facts.fact: 毁掉阿卡迪亚的是凡人
facts.anchor: it was they who destroyed Arcadia

facts.fact: 终局不在岛上而在罗马
facts.anchor: the city is where everything will end

facts.fact: 复生的大神在星光下终于微笑
facts.anchor: Under the dim starlight, the great god Pan, returned to life, finally smiles

facts.fact: Wendy 连办两场派对演出，Peter 比经纪人 Aldo 管用
facts.anchor: The Wondrous Wendy performed through the whole party

facts.fact: Peter 提醒林中有 Wild People
facts.anchor: “Don’t go too far,” Peter Pan advised them. “There are the Wild People.”

facts.fact: Tinker Bell 给的甜烟斗无麻醉力只松弛
facts.anchor: It doesn’t have narcotic effects; it’s just very relaxing

facts.fact: Giada 引 Gandalf 对 Frodo 之言
facts.anchor: “You remember what Gandalf said to Frodo, about that?”

facts.fact: 她若重来一百次仍杀 Noose
facts.anchor: if I went back I’d do the same again without a second thought

facts.fact: Giada 的自白核心：杀人后知道自己能杀人，这是巨大权力
facts.anchor: I killed him and now I know I can kill. It’s an immense power

facts.fact: Giada 定位二人：魔术师与清运工，非英雄
facts.anchor: We’re not heroes

facts.fact: 冷幽默：Noose 已成蕨类肥料
facts.anchor: Noose is already fertiliser for the ferns

facts.fact: Wendy 反问现实主义的立足点
facts.anchor: I’m in a land that never was and tomorrow I’m going to fight pirates. Why should I be realistic?

facts.fact: Giada 举 ch18 之夜 Zappo 抠眼事证海盗之真
facts.anchor: Zappo ripped out a middle-aged lady’s eye

facts.fact: Wendy 的方法论：让人开口即是魔术
facts.anchor: if you want information, you don’t ask, you let them talk

facts.fact: 章末 Giada 立誓永不再低估 Wendy
facts.anchor: never, never again will she underestimate the Wondrous Wendy
